commentary.text: 90+9' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+9' Moises Caicedo (Ecuador) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
90+7' The ball rebounds out to Christ Inao Oulai (Ivory Coast) on the edge of the box. He immediately strikes for goal, but sends the ball high over the bar.
90+7' Nilson Angulo (Ecuador) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.

90+6' Moises Caicedo (Ecuador) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Ecuador.
90+5' A cross from Angelo Preciado (Ecuador) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Ecuador.
90+4' Amad Diallo (Ivory Coast) latches on to an accurate pass into the box and immediately unleashes a low shot goalwards. His effort is well saved by the keeper.
90+3' Francois Letexier couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Moises Caicedo (Ecuador) and blew his whistle.
90' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
